text:
Kara N.: opened PR to expand the model-catalog entry for q4/q8 builds and add a short migration + SDK snippets (including Go example): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5203
Oleh M.: great — can you include explicit instance/precision in the perf table (a100-40gb q8, a100-80gb fp16) and the raw CSV link? customers want exact repro.
Kara N.: added an "instance / precision" column and linked CSV. also included a tiny note: 8-bit KV experimental and may change.
Vic R.: CI will fail unless we add snippet markers. also the Go SDK example needs to use `client.Text().Generate()` (old Go helper was different). Pushing a micro-fix to the branch.
Kara N.: thanks — please include SNIPPET_START/END markers for py/node/go and a CLI snippet.
bench-bot: bench upload: aether-7b-q8 - a100-40gb - median p95: 34ms (b1), 59ms (b8), 73ms (b16). CSV: s3://bench-uploads/5203/aether7b_q8.csv
Oleh M.: use median p95 in the table and add a notes cell recommending batch <=16; call out unstable tail with batch 32. also add tokens/sec for throughput (e.g., ~800 tps @b16 q8 on a100-40gb).
Vic R.: proposing a short compatibility row: "Quantized variants: streaming limited; function-calls: partial; long-context KV: experimental." also suggest adding a streaming workaround note: "If your app needs long-context streaming, prefer pinned fp16 variant or use shard+cache pattern."
Kara N.: added wording and the workaround note. also added migration snippet for pinning variants using `@q8-YYYY-MM-DD` format.
Oleh M.: quick ask: can we include a tiny Rust snippet? a few customers asked. keep it minimal.
Kara N.: added Rust example using `client.text().generate(...)` and markers `SNIPPET_START:sdk-rust-q-migrate`. kept output trimmed.
docs-bot: linkcheck failed for /model-catalog/aether-7b -> 404 (branch: kara/quantized-expand).
Kara N.: ah I moved the model-catalog card file while reorganizing directories; fixing the link now.
ci-bot: docs build failed - missing snippet marker `SNIPPET_START:cli-q` in model-card/aether-7b.md.
Vic R.: added the CLI snippet (old -> new) and pushed. snippet shows old `ri api text` -> new `ri text generate --model aether-7b@q8-2026-05-01`.
bench-bot: uploaded updated CSV after commit: s3://bench-uploads/5203/aether7b_q8_v2.csv
Oleh M.: small phrasing tweak on the compatibility note to emphasize pinning: "Pin model variant to guarantee behavior across releases." pushed fix.
ci-bot: build passed (job #2640) on branch kara/quantized-expand.
docs-bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview--docs.redwood.ai/model-catalog/aether-7b (branch: kara/quantized-expand)
Kara N.: preview looks good. one last request from product: can we backport the migration blurb to the Dedicated docs and add a short release note?
Vic R.: I'll do the backport and add a short line to the Dedicated release notes page.
Oleh M.: re-ran a quick bench with the final snippet in place; numbers stable. attaching CSV and merging now.
Kara N.: merged and backported. thanks all for quick help. closing thread. :tada:
